notes.title: 🧟‍♂️ Don't Worry, Be ZOMBIE 🧟‍♂️
notes.notes:
We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be 
available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 6 February 2023.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on February 6th, 2023. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.

Lead the world invasion by strategically placing sweet little zombies. You don't need to be afraid of different types of enemies, you also have different types of zombies. It is your duty to finish this conquest, which started as a result of an experiment. Step by step, world will come in your hands.

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
